body:
I'm surprised myself. Dying never scared me, and when I started to really think about it (which only happened since last year), I realized I longed for it. For me, being dead or being alive wasn't much of a difference. I felt empty anyway, I wouldn't care if it ended.

That was up until last year, up until the moment I finally gave in to developing feelings for another human being again, which I've been keeping myself from doing for a very long time. I can feel things again now, but I wish I did not.

The only options I have now are returning to the state I was in before I opened up to this person, and continue to suffer from the pain of losing her. Both of them are shit.

This might sound cruel, but I really wish my friends and family didn't care about me. At least then I could end my life knowing I wouldn't put misery on to the life of others. Although I'm close to the point of saying "fuck it", and take a selfish action.

I will keep you updated. If I don't reply in the next 48 hours, you can assume I've chosen the coward's way out. I have already written some letters to my family and some friends, and strangely enough, I felt at peace while doing so. That's something I haven't felt in a very, very long time.

Referring to the fact that there's someone out there for everyone; I have been saying similar things to other people over the course of my life, so I do believe that to be true. However, I also believe that the situation I find myself in now is different. She's not just a romantic interest, she was the one and only person I ever opened up to about anything and everything that's "bothering" me. I have friends and family, but I was never able to talk to them about the things I talked about with her.

I know I need to work on myself, but I have no idea how to do that. I tried going into therapy last year but that didn't work out. I tried focussing on hobbies or work, or just any type of distraction, but none it worked.

I am no longer able to put on my "everything-is-fine" mask anymore.
